DomiciliationPage.title: Domiciliation of your company in Brussels
DomiciliationPage.hero_p1: Set up your registered office in Brussels in a Business Center approved by the SPF Economy. Office Factory offers you a professional address at 842 Chaussée d'Alsemberg, 1180 Uccle — a flexible, affordable and fully compliant solution under Belgian law.
DomiciliationPage.hero_p2: Whether you are a freelancer, SRL/BV manager, ASBL/VZW founder or startup creator, our company domiciliation service in Brussels adapts to your situation.
DomiciliationPage.what_p1: In Belgium, every company or business must have a registered office listed with the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (CBE). This registered office is your company's official address: it is where administrative mail, court summons, SPF Finance documents and all official correspondence are received.
DomiciliationPage.what_p2: Company domiciliation means using the address of an approved business center as your company's registered office, rather than your private home. This service is regulated by the law of March 29, 2018, which requires every domiciliation provider to be registered and approved by the SPF Economy — an obligation that Office Factory scrupulously respects.
DomiciliationPage.what_p3: In practice, your company is officially registered at our address in Uccle (Brussels). We receive your mail, archive your official documents and ensure the legal compliance of your domiciliation. You retain the flexibility to work from wherever you want, while benefiting from a recognized professional address.
DomiciliationPage.included_subtitle: A complete service so you don't have to worry about anything.
DomiciliationPage.inc1_d: Your registered office at our prestigious address in Uccle, Brussels. Usable on your invoices, contracts and official documents.
DomiciliationPage.inc2_d: Daily reception and sorting of your mail. Mail forwarding or email notification options available.
DomiciliationPage.inc3_d: Secure physical storage of your statutes, articles of incorporation and official company documents, as required by law.
DomiciliationPage.inc4_d: Our center is approved by the SPF Economy. Your domiciliation complies with the law of March 29, 2018, with no risk of deregistration.
DomiciliationPage.why_1: SPF Economy approved business center — guaranteed legal compliance
DomiciliationPage.why_2: Over 35 years of experience in Brussels
DomiciliationPage.why_3: Member of the Belgian Workspace Association (BWA)
DomiciliationPage.why_4: Professional address in Uccle, a recognized residential and commercial area
DomiciliationPage.why_5: Receptionist for welcoming your visitors and clients

DomiciliationPage.step1_d: Fill out our online form or call us. We discuss your needs and send you a personalized offer within 24 hours.
DomiciliationPage.step2_d: Everything can be done 100% online. We prepare your domiciliation agreement compliant with SPF Economy requirements.
DomiciliationPage.step3_d: We register your company at our address. You can immediately use it for your CBE, VAT and all official correspondence.
DomiciliationPage.price_p1: Our domiciliation service is accessible from

DomiciliationPage.faq1_a: Yes, company domiciliation is perfectly legal in Belgium. Since the law of March 29, 2018, business centers offering this service must be approved by the SPF Economy. Office Factory holds this approval, guaranteeing full compliance of your domiciliation.
DomiciliationPage.faq2_q: What types of companies can be domiciled?
DomiciliationPage.faq2_a: All Belgian legal forms can be domiciled: SRL (BV), SA (NV), ASBL (VZW), SNC, SCS, SC, as well as sole traders. We also assist foreign companies wishing to establish a branch in Belgium.
DomiciliationPage.faq3_a: We receive and sort your mail daily. You can pick it up on site, request regular mail forwarding, or opt for email notification. Your mail is securely stored in our premises.
DomiciliationPage.faq4_q: Can I use the address on my invoices and official documents?
DomiciliationPage.faq4_a: Absolutely. The domiciliation address is your official registered office. You can use it on your invoices, contracts, business cards, website, and with all Belgian administrations (CBE, VAT, commercial court registry).
DomiciliationPage.faq5_q: How long does it take to set up domiciliation?
DomiciliationPage.faq5_a: Setup is fast. Once we receive your signed contract and required documents, your domiciliation can be active within 24 to 48 hours. The entire process can be done 100% digitally.
DomiciliationPage.faq6_q: What happens if I choose a non-approved center?
DomiciliationPage.faq6_a: Domiciling your company in a center not approved by the SPF Economy exposes you to serious risks: deregistration of your company number from the CBE, refusal of VAT number by tax authorities, and obligation to urgently find a new registered office.

DomiciliationSRLPage.title: Domiciliation for your SRL in Brussels
DomiciliationSRLPage.desc: Creating or managing an SRL (BV)? Domicile your registered office in Brussels at Office Factory, an SPF Economy approved business center. A compliant professional address for your limited liability company.
DomiciliationSRLPage.what_title: The SRL: Belgium's most popular legal form
DomiciliationSRLPage.what_p1: The Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SRL), known as Besloten Vennootschap (BV) in Dutch, has become the most common legal form in Belgium since the reform of the Companies and Associations Code (CSA) in 2019. It replaces the former SPRL and offers great flexibility to entrepreneurs.
DomiciliationSRLPage.what_p2: When incorporating an SRL, the notary must verify that the registered office is established at a valid address. By choosing an approved domiciliation center like Office Factory, you ensure this requirement is met correctly while maintaining the flexibility to work from wherever you want.
DomiciliationSRLPage.req1_d: Your SRL must be incorporated by notarial deed. The registered office appears in the statutes published in the Belgian Official Gazette.
DomiciliationSRLPage.req2_d: The domiciliation center must be approved. Office Factory has held this approval since the law came into force.
DomiciliationSRLPage.req3_d: A written contract between your SRL and our center is mandatory. We prepare this document in compliance with legal requirements.
DomiciliationSRLPage.req4_d: Your SRL is registered at our address with the CBE and VAT administration. We assist you with these procedures.
DomiciliationSRLPage.inc_1: Official registered office address in Uccle, Brussels
DomiciliationSRLPage.inc_3: Physical archiving of company statutes and deeds
DomiciliationSRLPage.inc_5: Assistance with CBE and VAT registration
DomiciliationSRLPage.price_p2: excl. VAT. Flexible contracts, no hidden fees.
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq1_q: Can you create an SRL directly with a domiciliation address?
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq1_a: Yes. When incorporating your SRL at the notary, you can indicate our address as the registered office. We provide you with a domiciliation agreement to present to the notary.
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq2_q: Do statutes need to be amended if I change domiciliation?
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq2_a: Yes, a transfer of registered office requires an amendment of statutes published in the Belgian Official Gazette. Our administrative procedures service can handle this for you.
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq3_q: Is SRL domiciliation accepted by banks?
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq3_a: Yes, Belgian banks accept domiciliation addresses from SPF Economy approved centers. Our approval guarantees problem-free acceptance.
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq4_q: Can I combine domiciliation with a physical office?
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq4_a: Absolutely. Many of our SRL clients start with domiciliation and then add a private office or coworking space as needed.
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq5_q: What happens in case of a tax audit?
DomiciliationSRLPage.faq5_a: In case of an audit, we keep your statutes and official documents on our premises, as required by law. The auditor can verify the reality of your domiciliation on site.

DomiciliationASBLPage.title: Domiciliation for your ASBL in Brussels
DomiciliationASBLPage.desc: Does your non-profit need an official registered office? Office Factory offers domiciliation for ASBL (VZW) in Brussels, in an SPF Economy approved center.
DomiciliationASBLPage.what_title: ASBL in Belgium: registered office obligations
DomiciliationASBLPage.what_p1: The Association Sans But Lucratif (ASBL), or Vereniging Zonder Winstoogmerk (VZW) in Dutch, is the legal form used by organizations pursuing a non-profit purpose in Belgium. Since the CSA reform, ASBLs are subject to similar obligations as commercial companies regarding registered offices.
DomiciliationASBLPage.what_p2: Every ASBL must have a registered office listed with the CBE. Domiciliation at an approved center like Office Factory allows your association to have a professional address without renting premises, representing significant savings for budget-conscious organizations.
DomiciliationASBLPage.req1_d: The ASBL pursues a non-profit purpose. Domiciliation is ideal for associations that don't need permanent premises.
DomiciliationASBLPage.req2_d: As with any company, the domiciliation center must be approved. Office Factory meets this legal requirement.
DomiciliationASBLPage.req3_d: The ASBL's statutes mention the registered office. We assist you with publication in the Belgian Official Gazette.
DomiciliationASBLPage.req4_d: The ASBL must keep a members register at its registered office. We can store this document in our premises.
DomiciliationASBLPage.inc_1: Registered office address for your ASBL in Brussels
DomiciliationASBLPage.inc_2: Reception and management of association mail
DomiciliationASBLPage.inc_3: Storage of statutes and members register
DomiciliationASBLPage.price_p2: excl. VAT. An affordable solution for associations.
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq1_q: Can an ASBL be domiciled in a business center?
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq1_a: Yes, since the CSA reform, ASBLs are treated as legal entities and can perfectly be domiciled in an SPF Economy approved business center like Office Factory.
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq2_q: What documents are needed to domicile an ASBL?
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq2_a: We need the ASBL's statutes, a copy of the CBE registration, and identity cards of the administrators. We then prepare the domiciliation agreement.
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq3_q: Must the members register be kept at the registered office?
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq3_a: Yes, the law requires the members register to be consultable at the registered office. We can store this document in our premises to meet this obligation.
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq4_q: Can the general assembly be held at your address?
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq4_a: Yes, we have meeting rooms that you can book for your general assemblies and board meetings.
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq5_q: Is there a special rate for ASBLs?
DomiciliationASBLPage.faq5_a: Our domiciliation rates are the same for all legal forms, starting at €79/month excl. VAT. Contact us to discuss your specific needs.
